title: Exam Technique and Final Review

header.html: All domains: adaptive exam technique, numbers to memorize, look-alike terms and decision rules
Apply a repeatable method to every question; recall the facts, models and acronyms of all five domains; separate look-alike terms
the official ISC2 CC exam outline

toc.title: Five questions to ask in every scenario

html:
1Technique for an adaptive exam

Item Advice
Format 100 to 125 items in 2 hours, no item review; answer each item as it comes
Difficulty Items aim at a 50 percent chance of a right answer, so expect them to feel hard
Pretest items 25 items do not count and look the same: treat every item seriously
Time About one minute per item; do not stall; never leave a blank
Length A longer exam is not a bad sign
Method Last line first, find the domain, eliminate two answers, pick the best one
Exam tip

. Two answers are usually wrong at once. Then ask "which is preventive, within policy, least privilege, and the first step?"

2Look-alike pairs

Pair Difference
Due care and due diligence Act and maintain and investigate first
Policy, standard, procedure, guideline What and why, which, how, optional advice
RTO and RPO Time to be back and data you can lose
BCP and DRP Keep the business running and restore IT
Vulnerability scan and penetration test Find weaknesses and exploit them
Phishing, spear phishing, whaling Many, one person, an executive
Rogue AP and evil twin Unauthorized device and fake copy of a real network
Stateless and stateful firewall Each packet alone and remembers connections
IDS and IPS Alert and block
DAC, MAC, RBAC, ABAC Owner, labels, roles, attributes
PoLP and SoD How much access and who completes a task
Symmetric, asymmetric, hash One key, key pair, no key
Masking and sanitization Hide part of a value and remove data from media
KPI and KRI Performance and early warning
True positive, false positive, false negative Real alert, harmless alert, missed attack
Inherent and residual risk Before controls and after controls

3Numbers and facts to memorize

Topic Fact
Exam 100 to 125 items, 2 hours, 700 of 1000, 25 unscored, at least 75 scored
Domain weights 24, 17.3, 20, 21.3, 17.3 percent
Risk formulas SLE = AV times EF; ALE = SLE times ARO
Risk treatments Avoid, mitigate, transfer, accept
IR phases Prepare, detect and analyze, contain, eradicate, recover, learn
Ports SSH 22, Telnet 23, DNS 53, HTTP 80, HTTPS 443, RDP 3389
OSI 7 layers; router 3, switch 2, port 4
IP IPv4 32 bits, IPv6 128 bits
Cloud 5 characteristics, IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, customer always owns data and access
Code of Ethics 4 canons in order: society first
Exam tip

. Review the lists you can rattle off: CIA, AAA, IR phases, life cycle steps, cloud characteristics, canons.

4Five questions to ask in every scenario

Question Why
Which goal is at stake? (confidentiality, integrity, availability) Finds the control family
Which domain is it? Finds the right vocabulary
What is the first step? Many answers are too late
Is it least privilege and policy-based? The safe default
Is it preventive and simple? Prefer prevent over fix
Exam tip

. If you do not know, eliminate the extreme answers (do nothing, ignore policy, the most drastic fix) and choose the measured, policy-based answer.

5Exam Q&A

5.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A candidate reaches item 100 and the exam continues. What does this mean?

  • AThe candidate has failed the exam
  • BThe remaining items are all unscored
  • CThe candidate may now review all earlier items
  • DThe system needs more items to be confident
Show the answer

Answer: D. After the minimum length the exam continues until the system is 95 percent confident or a limit is reached; a longer exam is not a sign of failure.

S2Which two terms describe how much data can be lost and how long recovery may take?

  • ARTO for data loss and RPO for recovery time
  • BALE for data loss and SLE for recovery time
  • CMTTD for data loss and MTTR for recovery time
  • DRPO for data loss and RTO for recovery time
Show the answer

Answer: D. The recovery point objective is acceptable data loss and the recovery time objective is the time to restore.

S3A user needs temporary access to a system to fix an issue. What principle guides the grant?

  • ADefense in depth, using many layers
  • BNon-repudiation, preventing denial
  • CLeast privilege, with only needed access
  • DData minimization, which collects less personal data
Show the answer

Answer: C. Grant only the needed access for the needed time.

S4Which control type is a security awareness training program?

  • ATechnical, because it uses a computer
  • BPhysical, because it takes place in a room
  • CCompensating, because it replaces a firewall
  • DAdministrative, because it is a people and policy control
Show the answer

Answer: D. Training is an administrative control.

S5A company stores its web shop in a public cloud virtual machine. Who patches the guest operating system?

  • AThe cloud provider
  • BThe payment processor
  • CThe customer
  • DThe domain registrar
Show the answer

Answer: C. In IaaS the customer manages and patches the operating system.

S6An analyst finds that an incident is spreading between servers. What is the best next step?

  • ARebuild all the servers at once
  • BContain it by isolating the affected servers
  • CWait for the next scheduled scan
  • DPublish the details on social media
Show the answer

Answer: B. Containment limits the spread before eradication and recovery.

5.2 Recall questions

R1What is the passing grade?

Show the answer

700 out of 1000.

R2Which domain is the largest?

Show the answer

Security Principles, 24 percent.

R3What are the CIA goals?

Show the answer

Confidentiality, integrity, availability.

R4What are the identity life cycle stages?

Show the answer

Roles definition, provision, review, deprovision.

R5What does zero trust say?

Show the answer

Never trust, always verify.

R6Who decides data classification?

Show the answer

The data owner.

6Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Method last line, domain, eliminate, preventive and policy-based answer
Adaptive 100 to 125 items, no review, 25 unscored, longer is not worse
Look-alikes due care vs diligence, RTO vs RPO, scan vs pen test, IDS vs IPS
Defaults least privilege, first step, contain before eradicate, customer owns data
